about_page.hero_headline: Building the infrastructure for Europe's mobile circular economy.
about_page.hero_body: Remobile Tech GmbH is the Vienna-based holding company behind Remobile.eu, HandySwap.com, and Remobile.ae.
about_page.story_p1: Remobile Tech GmbH was incorporated in Austria as the holding company consolidating the Remobile group's European operations. We serve as the legal and commercial backbone for our consumer brands and wholesale supply activities across the continent.
about_page.story_p2: Our operating companies serve consumers, independent retailers, and major distributors across more than 40 countries. The group moves over 10,000 certified devices per month, with full EU documentation on every transaction.
about_page.director_bio: Hassib has built the Remobile group from a single Dubai operation into a multi-brand European holding. He oversees strategy, wholesale partnerships, and operations across all group entities.

brands_page.hero_body: The Remobile group operates across Europe and the Middle East through four complementary brands, each serving a distinct market segment.
brands_page.remobile_eu_body: Our EU-focused consumer and B2B brand. We sell certified refurbished iPhones and Android devices to consumers and business customers across Europe, backed by full EU warranty and documentation on every unit.
brands_page.handyswap_body: A consumer marketplace for buying and selling pre-owned phones, focused on the DACH region. HandySwap provides a trusted platform for individuals and small businesses to trade mobile devices at fair prices.
brands_page.remobile_ae_body: Our Dubai facility — a 52-point inspection and refurbishment centre in Port Saeed. We supply certified stock to UAE customers and international wholesale buyers, with full IMEI-level traceability on every device.
brands_page.remobileb2b_body: Our upcoming international B2B wholesale platform, connecting distributors worldwide with certified refurbished stock from Dubai and EU warehouses. Built for institutional buyers placing 50–1,000+ unit orders.

wholesale_page.hero_headline: Grade-A refurbished stock for European distributors.
wholesale_page.hero_body: We supply certified refurbished and new mobile phones at scale to distributors, independent retailers, and chain operators across DACH and Benelux.
wholesale_page.step1_body: Send an inquiry via the form below or email wholesale@remobiletech.com. Tell us what you need and we'll respond within 24 hours.
wholesale_page.step2_body: We assess your requirements — device models, grades, quantities, and delivery region — and provide a tailored price quote.
wholesale_page.step3_body: Every order includes CE certificates, a VAT invoice or VAT-margin invoice, and per-unit data erasure certificates.
wholesale_page.step4_body: Shipped from EU or Dubai depending on stock and your preference. Lead times confirmed with every order.

privacy_page.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: This privacy policy explains how Remobile Tech GmbH collects, uses, and protects personal data on remobiletech.com. We are committed to GDPR compliance and to handling your data with care.
privacy_page.s1_body: The data controller responsible for this website is Remobile Tech GmbH, Jordangasse 7/12, A-1010 Vienna, Austria. Managing Director: Hassib Atta Mian. Contact: info@remobiletech.com.
privacy_page.s2_body: We collect personal data only when you actively provide it. When you submit a wholesale inquiry, we collect: your full name, your company name (optional), your email address, and the content of your message. We do not collect data through analytics, tracking scripts, or passive browsing.
privacy_page.s3_body: Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — the processing is necessary for taking steps prior to entering into a contract at your request. If you do not submit an inquiry, no personal data is processed.
privacy_page.s4_body: We use Resend (Resend Inc., 185 Alewife Brook Pkwy, Suite 210, Cambridge, MA 02138, USA) to deliver inquiry emails. When you submit a form, your name and email address are processed by Resend's infrastructure. Resend provides appropriate safeguards for transatlantic data transfers. For details, see resend.com/privacy.
privacy_page.s5_body: Under the GDPR you have the right to request access to, correction of, or erasure of your personal data; to request restriction of processing; to data portability; and to object to processing. To exercise these rights, write to info@remobiletech.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Austrian data protection authority: Datenschutzbehörde, Barichgasse 40-42, 1030 Vienna — dsb@dsb.gv.at — www.dsb.gv.at.
privacy_page.s6_body: Inquiry data is retained for a maximum of three years from receipt. Data is deleted sooner if no business relationship materialises, or upon a valid erasure request.
privacy_page.s7_body: This website uses only technically necessary session cookies required for the site to function. We do not use analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking cookies. No cookie consent banner is displayed because no consent-requiring cookies are set.
privacy_page.s8_body: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable law. The current version is always available at remobiletech.com/privacy. Material changes will be indicated by updating the 'last updated' date above.
privacy_page.s9_body: For data protection enquiries: Remobile Tech GmbH, Jordangasse 7/12, A-1010 Vienna — info@remobiletech.com.
